content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Music online

Selling music online typically involves using platforms that charge significant fees, cutting into your profits. For instance, Gumroad charges 10% on every sale, whereas using NOWPayments for cryptocurrency transactions reduces this to just 0.5%. For musicians selling a $97 product, this fee difference can retain over $900 at 100 sales per month. This not only enhances your profitability but also grants you more control over your digital assets and customer relationships.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture of a sovereign digital commerce stack works seamlessly to facilitate sales without conventional payment processors. It typically includes free hosting through platforms like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, backend logic powered by Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, and order management through databases like Supabase. This structure ensures that creators can automatically deliver their products while confirming payments via NOWPayments, all while maintaining full ownership of their data and assets.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This solution is specifically designed for digital creators in regions with restricted access to mainstream payment platforms. Whether you're a musician, a course creator, or a template designer, this infrastructure empowers you to sell your work without high fees or dependence on third-party services. By using a sovereign digital commerce stack, you can operate independently, ensuring that your revenue remains intact and your products reach your customers without barriers.
Save more of your revenue by cutting out high platform fees.
The Components That Make It Work Together

A complete sovereign commerce stack consists of several key components that work together to ensure efficiency and reliability. You start with free hosting from GitHub or Cloudflare, integrate backend processing with Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, and utilize NOWPayments for cryptocurrency transactions. This combination allows for automatic payment processing and product delivery, ensuring a seamless experience for both you and your customers while minimizing costs.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To set up your sovereign digital commerce stack, begin by selecting a hosting service like GitHub Pages. Next, configure the backend logic with Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers. After that, set up your order management system using Supabase or Google Sheets. Lastly, integrate NOWPayments to handle cryptocurrency transactions. This complete process can be facilitated through the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which contains all the necessary blueprints and templates for immediate deployment.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

The fastest path to your first sovereign digital product sale is a three-step process. First, create a NOWPayments account — configure your wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as starting points, generate your API key, and set the webhook endpoint URL. Second, choose your stack: Stack 01 uses GitHub Pages plus Google Apps Script and takes most creators four to six hours following the Sovereign Blueprint at $47; Stack 02 uses Cloudflare Pages plus Workers plus Supabase and is deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours with the Edge Commerce Stack at $197. Third, upload your product files, set your prices in USD, and run a complete mainnet test transaction before promoting.
Retain full ownership of your digital products and customer data.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you're interested in selling digital downloads, including ebooks or templates, without facing platform fees, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197). This kit provides all the blueprints and templates needed to build your sovereign stack and can be found at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.

You can sell an ebook by setting up a sovereign digital commerce stack that utilizes NOWPayments for processing cryptocurrency transactions. This allows you to avoid traditional payment processors entirely.

By using backend solutions like Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers, you can automate the delivery of your digital products immediately after payment confirmation.
